set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 700 /etc/nginx/tls /etc/ssl/private
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/ssl/private/secure-web-root-ca.key
openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/ssl/private/secure-web-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/secure-web-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=Secure Web Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/secure-web-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/secure-web-root-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/secure-web-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -fingerprint -sha256

set -eu
umask 077
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out /etc/nginx/tls/server.key
openssl req -new -sha256 -key /etc/nginx/tls/server.key -out /etc/nginx/tls/server.csr -subj "/CN=$NODE_NAME" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$NODE_NAME,IP:$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE' 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment' 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth' "subjectAltName=DNS:$NODE_NAME,IP:$NODE_IP" 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid,issuer' > /etc/nginx/tls/server.ext
openssl x509 -req -sha256 -days 397 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.csr -CA /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/secure-web-root-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/ssl/private/secure-web-root-ca.key -CAserial /etc/ssl/private/secure-web-root-ca.srl -CAcreateserial -out /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -extfile /etc/nginx/tls/server.ext
chmod 600 /etc/nginx/tls/server.key
chmod 644 /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt
rm -f /etc/nginx/tls/server.csr /etc/nginx/tls/server.ext
openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName
